about: The checks behind 'Settings that cost you money' (/context-guru:save-more settings). ONE list: costly.py (the plugin) reads it, and proxy/dash must keep the same price shapes (dash/costlysettings.go; a Go test compares them). Metadata only: a price shape is request columns (model, tools, system_blocks, max_tokens, stream, messages), never request text. The dashboard counts the system prompt as a message, so a messages value here is the wire count plus 1.

checks.title: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS=1
checks.what: turns off the free server-side check in auto mode, so Claude Code sends its own classifier requests and you pay for them

shapes.label: classifier requests
shapes.note: No system_blocks or messages: the third system block is not always sent, so a classifier request has 2 or 3 blocks.

fix.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS
fix.text: remove it. Do not add CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER: the default already asks the server.
fix.effect: Takes effect at the next Claude Code session.

checks.risk: A gateway that rejects beta fields may return 400 errors. Claude Code 2.1.304 and later retries some of them itself. If errors start, undo this and run /context-guru:doctor.
checks.also_changes: Tool search halves the tools field (58.5 KB to 28.6 KB), and context_management turns on.

checks.title: Session recap (awaySummaryEnabled)
checks.what: makes a model call for a one-line summary each time you come back after a few minutes away

price.saves: one small model call each time you come back after a few minutes away

fix.effect: Takes effect at the next Claude Code session.

checks.risk: You no longer see the recap line when you come back.

checks.title: Small model {model}
checks.what: rejects the free auto-mode server check on Bedrock gateways, so Claude Code can send billed classifier requests

note_when.fires: This matters after you remove the betas setting above.
note_when.silent: The betas setting is off, so the small model can cause billed classifier requests now.

checks.cost_note: (also counted under the betas setting while it is on)

shapes.label: classifier requests in sessions with a Haiku 400

fix.done: set the small model to claude-haiku-5-5
fix.text: set ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL and ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL to claude-haiku-5-5.
fix.effect: Takes effect at the next Claude Code session.

checks.risk: Haiku 5.5 costs more per token than Haiku 4.5. It handles only small side requests, such as session titles. Check that your gateway serves claude-haiku-5-5 first.
